score_evidence.A: Clean claim-headed H2 arc, TL;DR four questions, $$-only math, valid front matter (subtitle, paper_author, paper_doi, use_math). Deductions: L300 denominator '{% raw %}{{\pi}_{\mathrm{old}}{% endraw %}(y_{i}|x)' mixes Liquid raw into math and uses '|' as a conditional bar; L488 '### References' sits as an H3 under '## 한계와 시사점'; no SFT section and no verifiable-rewards subsection under the RL H2 (L292-331).
score_evidence.B: Natural 입니다 register overall. L217 '희소도 48만으로도' reads as 480,000 (rewrite: '희소도 48만 되어도 이미'); L478 '자기 단서 달기' is a calque of self-qualification (rewrite: '스스로 확신을 낮추는 단서'); L153 '두 번째 요소는 다이어그램 하나로 정리됩니다.' formulaic figure lead-in; L150 '...피할 수 있습니다' for what simply happens; '앞서 본' used as a connector many times (L187, L250, L290, L329, L375, L402, L417, L451, L471, L480).
score_evidence.C: Good concept-before-use and cross-links. Repetition: QK-Clip logits capped at tau then decaying stated at L125 and again at L250; rubric filtering stated at L284 and restated at L290 in back-to-back paragraphs; H2D-bound limitation at L363 repeated at L480; L260 '구체적인 방식은 뒤의 궤적 생성 부분에서 다룹니다' is a forward-pointer meta sentence.
score_evidence.D: Hard parts get help at the right moment: the S_max=200 head example (L54, L98, L108), the per-component sqrt(gamma) reasoning (L108), the K=4 reward toy table (L306-313), the airline rubric example (L286). Mild padding on easy points (L157 diagram walkthrough, L231 'speedup 수치는 담고 있지 않습니다').
score_evidence.E: Figures described by content; tables copy cells verbatim (rephrasing, architecture, safety 25 cells all match). Deductions: L392 table cell '72.5 (그림 1 표시값)' and L396 '그림 1에 표시된 값' use the paper's figure numbering; L390-394 SWE table puts different comparison models in one column.
score_evidence.F: 15 sampled claims all supported. Outside the sample: L31 and L379 'temperature 0.0' is not in the paper (only 'unified temperature and top-p settings'); L375 '여러 패널에서 K2가 가장 높지만 SWE-bench Verified 패널에서는 ... 낮습니다' implies that is the only exception, but Figure 1 also has Claude 4 Opus 67.6 > 66.1 on Tau2-bench, GPT-4.1 80.1 > 76.5 on AceBench and Claude 4 Sonnet 51.0 > 47.3 on SWE-bench Multilingual; L300 '(y_{i}|x)' instead of \mid; L125 claims the 30%-of-training stabilisation 'roughly overlaps' the 70000-step clipping window, an inference the paper does not state.
